orgDesign.companyProfile: Multi-sided local delivery marketplace for consumers, merchants, couriers, grocery and retail partners, advertisers, and operations teams.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Consumer teams own discovery, ordering, membership, tracking, and support. Merchant teams own partner onboarding, catalog, operations, ads, promotions, and reporting. Courier teams own work access, dispatch, earnings, routing, and safety. Shared foundation teams own pricing, identity, risk, ledger, data, experimentation, APIs, and marketplace operations.
designPrinciples: Keep consumer promise, merchant prep, and courier dispatch metrics connected because delivery quality is a three-sided outcome.
Separate merchant growth tooling from marketplace pricing and ads measurement to keep commercial incentives explicit.
Treat identity, risk, ledger, and data as shared platform capabilities with strict ownership.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Use top-level groups for consumer marketplace, merchant and retail growth, courier logistics, and marketplace foundations.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
